road.title: It's not just a stay. It's part of the ride.
road.lede: Because every road deserves a great place to end. From the ghat roads to the hidden beaches, we choose places that make sense at the end of a long day on a bike — and hosts who understand why you arrived at midnight.

riderFriendly.title: What rider-friendly means here
riderFriendly.lede: Secure parking, scenic locations, group-friendly stays. It is not a badge we hand out — a stay earns it by having the things that decide whether a long day on a bike ends well.
riderFriendly.body: Most listing sites will tell you a place is good for bikers. Almost none of them will tell you whether there is a roof over the parking, whether the gate is manned at midnight, or whether there is a tap you can rinse the salt off with before it eats the chrome. Those are the questions we ask before a property goes on this site, and the answers are printed on every listing.

about.title: Where stays meet stories
about.lede: StaySutra is India's rider-friendly stay network — built on one idea: that where you sleep is part of the ride, not an afterthought at the end of it.

listProperty.title: Own a villa, farmhouse or resort?
listProperty.lede: Turn your property into a professionally managed stay. Four steps, about ten minutes. We review every submission ourselves and come back to you within two working days.

steps.title: Tell us about the property
steps.body: Who you are, where it is, and what kind of place it is.

steps.title: What it offers
steps.body: Capacity, amenities and — the part that matters here — what you have for the bikes.

steps.title: Photos and documents
steps.body: Pictures of the place, plus proof you are entitled to list it.

steps.title: Review and submit
steps.body: Check it over, agree to the terms, and send it to us.
